android.desc:
AirDisk Pro is a wireless file transfer and file manager app that helps you move photos, videos, folders, documents, music, and archives between your phone, tablet, and computer.

Use local WiFi transfer to access your phone files from a computer browser. Open AirDisk Pro, connect your computer to the same WiFi network, enter the browser address shown in the app, and start uploading or downloading files. No cable, no desktop software, and no cloud upload required for local WiFi transfer.

AirDisk Pro is useful when you want to:

• Transfer photos from Android phone or tablet to Windows PC
• Move videos from phone to computer
• Send documents from computer to phone
• Transfer files over WiFi using a browser
• Access phone files without installing desktop software
• Organize folders, media, documents, and archives
• Manage files locally on your mobile device
• Use cloud storage when needed

Key features:

Wireless WiFi File Transfer
Transfer files between your phone and computer over the same local WiFi network. Use your computer browser to upload, download, and manage files.

Photo and Video Transfer
Move photos and videos from your phone to your computer without using a cable. This is helpful for backing up camera roll media, moving large videos, or freeing up phone storage.

Browser-Based Transfer
Access your files from a Mac, Windows PC, Chromebook, or other computer with a web browser. No desktop companion app is required for local WiFi transfer.

File Manager
Create folders, rename files, move files, copy files, delete files, organize folders, and manage your local storage from one place.

Document Viewer
Preview common document formats including PDF, Microsoft Office files, Apple iWork files, images, text files, and more.

Archive Tools
Zip, unzip, and manage archive files directly inside the app.

Music and Video Player
Play music and videos stored in AirDisk Pro with built-in media player support.

Cloud Storage Support
Connect to iCloud, Google Drive, Dropbox, OneDrive, Box, FTP, and WebDAV when you want to access or manage cloud files.

Privacy and Local Transfer
For local WiFi transfer, your files are transferred through your local network instead of requiring cloud upload. Your phone and computer must be connected to the same WiFi network, and AirDisk Pro should stay open while transferring files.

AirDisk Pro is designed for people who want a practical way to transfer files wirelessly, manage document

quotes.text:
Hi HN,

I’m an indie hacker and just launched the Android version of my app, AirDisk Pro. It’s a private, offline-first file manager that includes:
• Wireless file & photo transfers over Wi-Fi
• Media playback for video, music, and images
• Full local storage access (like a USB drive for your phone)
• No cloud sync required unless configured

The iOS version has been downloaded by over 1 million users – and now Android users can enjoy the same experience.

Google Play: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.app2pro.airdisk
Site: airdisk.app

Would love your thoughts, ideas, or brutal feedback. Always learning!
